CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tg_departments_probation_enabled_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
-- B4C:probation — probation_enabled changes only through set_probation_enabled (or the SQL editor), never a direct
-- client UPDATE (departments takes direct UPDATEs for its other settings).
begin
  if new.probation_enabled is distinct from old.probation_enabled and current_user in ('anon', 'authenticated') then
    raise exception 'Only a Department Admin can turn the probation program on or off.';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$function$

dept_drill_plans().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.dept_drill_plans()
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, title text, category text, duration_min integer, audience text, content jsonb, status text, source text, created_by uuid, created_at timestamp with time zone, approved_by uuid, approved_at timestamp with time zone, updated_by uuid, updated_at timestamp with time zone, attached_sessions integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  -- B4C:drill plans — the caller's department library (any member), with how many session plans point at each.
  select p.id, p.title, p.category, p.duration_min, p.audience, p.content, p.status, p.source,
         p.created_by, p.created_at, p.approved_by, p.approved_at, p.updated_by, p.updated_at,
         (select count(*)::int from public.session_plans sp where sp.drill_plan_id = p.id and sp.department_id = p.department_id)
    from public.drill_plans p
   where p.department_id = public.my_department_id()
   order by p.status, p.updated_at desc, p.title;
  $function$

library_drill_usage().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.library_drill_usage()
 RETURNS TABLE(library_id uuid, held integer, departments integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
    -- B4C:library slice 1 — "used" (L3) = a copy attached to a session that was finalized, not cancelled, and attended.
    -- COUNTS ONLY: never which department, never who. Members only (a stray login gets nothing).
      SELECT l.id,
             count(DISTINCT s.id)::int,
             count(DISTINCT s.department_id)::int
        FROM public.library_drills l
        JOIN public.drill_plans dp ON dp.library_id = l.id
        JOIN public.session_plans sp ON sp.drill_plan_id = dp.id AND sp.department_id = dp.department_id
        JOIN public.training_sessions s ON s.id = sp.session_id AND s.department_id = dp.department_id
       WHERE public.my_member_id() IS NOT NULL
         AND l.state = 'published' AND s.done AND s.status <> 'cancelled'
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.session_attendance a WHERE a.session_id = s.id)
       GROUP BY l.id
    $function$

my_member_id().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_member_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select id
  from public.members
  where lower(email) = lower(auth.email())
    and status in ('Active','Probationary')
    and department_id = public.my_department_id()
  limit 1;
$function$

my_department_id().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_department_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(
    -- 1) the saved active station, ONLY if it's still one of the caller's departments
    ( select mad.department_id
        from public.member_active_department mad
       where mad.email = lower(auth.email())
         and exists ( select 1 from public.members m
                       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
                         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
                         and m.department_id = mad.department_id ) ),
    -- 2) else their department, deterministically. Single-dept = byte-identical to the old body.
    ( select m.department_id
        from public.members m
       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
       order by m.department_id
       limit 1 )
  );
$function$

is_training_officer().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_training_officer()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  -- B4C:training officers — an ACTIVE registry row for the caller's member row in the caller's department. Department-scoped
  -- (unlike is_equipment_manager()): an officer of one department is not one in another.
    select exists (
      select 1 from public.training_officer t
       where t.member_id = public.my_member_id()
         and t.department_id = public.my_department_id()
         and t.removed_at is null
    );
  $function$

is_training_manager().def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_training_manager()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  -- B4C:training officers — THE training-management gate: a Department Admin in the caller's department (not Project Admin —
  -- deliberately not is_dept_admin()) OR an active training officer there. Schedules / edits / completes / reopens sessions
  -- (meetings and board events included), marks the roster, manages categories and the drill-plan library.
    select exists (
      select 1 from public.members m
       where lower(m.email) = lower(auth.email())
         and m.status in ('Active','Probationary')
         and m.department_id = public.my_department_id()
         and m.access && array['Department Admin']::text[]
    ) or public.is_training_officer();
  $function$
